annotations.title: Check your Soclo credits and plan

description: Read the connected account’s credit balance, current plan (tier, state, renewal, monthly allotment) and the recent credit ledger: the money rows that show what actually left or arrived, newest first, each with the signed movement, its reason, the balance it left behind and the receipt id the spend tools return. A spend is negative, credits returned after a failed job are a positive refund, and a store refund or chargeback that removes awarded credits is a negative reversal — read the sign, never the label alone. Read-only and free. The balance and the ledger are separate reads, so they are adjacent observations rather than one snapshot. This ledger — not any generation reply — is what confirms a charge or a refund, so read it after a failed or interrupted generation before telling the owner what something cost. If it returns ledgerUnavailable instead of the rows, the ledger could not be read: say so plainly rather than reporting that nothing was spent. Check the balance BEFORE starting a run of video generation — it is the spending ceiling, and running out midway leaves work half done. Note this does not cap advertising spend on Meta or Google, which sits outside Soclo credits.
